<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long mod = 1000000007;
const long INF = (long)1e18 + 1;

struct InputReader {
    FILE *stream;
    char *buf;
    int curChar;
    int numChars;

    InputReader(FILE *stream) {
        this->stream = stream;
        buf = new char[1024];
    }

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) {
            throw Exception();
        }
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
            if (numChars <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return atoi(next());
    }

    string next() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = read();
        }
        stringstream res(c);
        do {
            res << c;
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));

        return res.str();
    }

    private:
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

struct Tuple {
    long d;
    int x;
    int y;
    int z;

    Tuple(long d, int x, int y, int z) {
        this->d = d;
        this->x = x;
        this->y = y;
        this->z = z;
    }
};

void pn(long zx) {
    cout << zx << endl;
}

const int N = 200;
int nCr[N][N];
long mod_inv[N + 1];

void precalc() {
    mod_inv[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
        mod_inv[i] = mod_inv[i - 1] * (mod - mod / i) % mod;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        nCr[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }
}

long f(long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p *= nCr[a][b];
    p %= mod;
    p *= nCr[c][d];
    p %= mod;
    return p;
}

int main() {
    FILE *in = freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
    FILE *out = freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout);
    InputReader in(in);
    InputReader buf = *(new InputReader(stdin));
    genders output;
    int K;

    precalc();

    int n = in.nextInt();
    int K = in.nextInt();
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (in.nextInt() == 50)
            cnt1++;
        else
            cnt2++;
    }

    long dist[N][N][2];
    long dp[N][N][2];
    fill(dist[0][0], dist[0][0] + sizeof(dist) / (2 * sizeof(long)), INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            for (int z = 0; z < 2; z++) {
                if (i + j == cnt1 + cnt2)
                    dist[i][j][z] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;

    priority_queue<Tuple, vector<Tuple>, greater<Tuple>> pq;

    pq.push(Tuple(0, 0, 0, 0));
    while (pq.size() > 0) {
        Tuple curr = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        int x = curr.x;
        int y = curr.y;
        int z = curr.z;
        long d = dist[x][y][z];

        if (z == 0) {
            int rem_x = cnt1 - x;
            int rem_y = cnt2 - y;

            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    int a1 = 0, b1 = cnt2 - j, c1 = x + i, d1 = y + j;
                    int a2 = cnt1 - i, b2 = j, c2 = x + i, d2 = y + j;
                    if (a1 * 50 + b1 * 100 > K)
                        break;
                    if (dist[a1][b1][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                        dist[a1][b1][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                        pq.push(Tuple(dist[a1][b1][z ^ 1], a1, b1, z ^ 1));
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] += f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j) % mod;
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] %= mod;
                    } else {
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] += f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j) % mod;
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] %= mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rem_x = x;
            int rem_y = y;

            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    int a1 = x - i, b1 = y - j, c1 = x - i, d1 = y - j;
                    int a2 = i, b2 = j, c2 = x - i, d2 = y - j;
                    if (a1 * 50 + b1 * 100 > K)
                        break;
                    if (dist[a1][b1][z ^ 1] >= d + 1) {
                        dist[a1][b1][z ^ 1] = d + 1;
                        pq.push(Tuple(dist[a1][b1][z ^ 1], a1, b1, z ^ 1));
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] += f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j) % mod;
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] %= mod;
                    } else {
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] += f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j) % mod;
                        dp[a1][b1][z ^ 1] %= mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF)
        pn(-1);
    else
        pn(dist[cnt1][cnt2][1]);

    pn(dp[cnt1][cnt2][1]);

    fclose(in);
    fclose(out);

    return 0;
}
